title: Dynamically Allocating Evaluation Effort for Model Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2608.03437v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While human evaluation is the gold standard in many NLP tasks, it suffers from prohibitive costs and poor scalability. When identifying top-performing models, typical evaluation protocols waste effort by exhaustively evaluating all models on the entire benchmark, a safe but inefficient approach. In this work, we formalize multi-model human evaluation as a best-arm identification problem in a multi-armed bandit setup with correlated arms, where pulling an arm corresponds to human-evaluating a model. By sampling adaptively based on the intermediate model rankings obtained on the samples so far, we can focus the annotation budget on the most competitive models. We prove the optimality of the proposed algorithms and show that it improves discrimination between top-performing models. This makes evaluations faster, cheaper and more aligned with large-scale competition evaluation goals.

translated_title: 用于模型排名的动态评估资源分配
translated_abstract: 尽管人工评估在许多自然语言处理（NLP）任务中是黄金标准，但它存在成本高昂和可扩展性差的问题。在识别表现最佳的模型时，典型的评估协议会在完整基准上对所有模型进行穷举评估，这种做法虽然安全但效率低下，浪费了大量评估精力。在这项工作中，我们将多模型人工评估形式化为具有相关臂的多臂老虎机设置中的最优臂识别问题，其中拉动手臂对应于对某个模型进行人工评估。通过基于目前为止在样本上获得的中间模型排名进行自适应采样，我们可以将标注预算集中在最具竞争力的模型上。我们证明了所提出算法的最优性，并表明该方法改善了对表现最佳模型之间的区分能力。这使得评估更快、更便宜，并且更符合大规模竞赛评估的目标。
tldr: 该论文将多模型人工评估形式化为具有相关臂的多臂老虎机最优臂识别问题，通过基于中间模型排名的自适应采样将标注预算集中在最具竞争力的模型上，并证明了算法的最优性，从而使评估更快、更便宜且更高效。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes multi-model human evaluation as a best-arm identification problem in multi-armed bandits with correlated arms, adaptively allocating annotation budget to the most competitive models based on intermediate rankings, and proves algorithmic optimality, enabling faster, cheaper, and more efficient evaluations.
